title: Understanding Orthogonality
text: In linear algebra, two vectors are orthogonal if their dot product is zero. This means they are perpendicular to each other in the vector space.

title: OLS Predictions and Residuals
text: The residuals in an OLS model are the differences between the observed values and the predicted values. Mathematically, this is represented as Y-hat minus Y.

title: Properties of OLS Residuals
text: One key property of OLS residuals is that they are orthogonal to the predicted values. This means the dot product of the residuals and the predictions is zero.
